items.exampleEn: Her literary works are read in many countries.
items.exampleZh: 她的文學作品在許多國家都有人讀。

items.exampleEn: My mother sells her crafts at the weekend market.
items.exampleZh: 我媽媽在週末市集賣她的手工藝品。

items.exampleEn: My grandfather was a poet and a teacher.
items.exampleZh: 我爺爺是詩人，也是老師。

items.exampleEn: I don't understand much poetry, but I like this poem.
items.exampleZh: 我不太懂詩，但我喜歡這首詩。

items.exampleEn: Our tent was next to the river.
Many myths tell stories about the sun and moon.
items.exampleZh: 許多神話講述關於太陽和月亮的故事。

items.exampleEn: In this book, the narrative moves between the past and the present.
items.exampleZh: 這本書的敘事在過去和現在之間來回切換。

items.exampleEn: We watched a comedy and laughed all night.
items.exampleZh: 我們看了一部喜劇，笑了一整晚。

items.exampleEn: The team's win was a small miracle.
items.exampleZh: 這支球隊能贏，算是個小奇蹟。

items.sentenceEn: The children slept in a tent in the garden.
items.sentenceZh: 孩子們在花園裡的帳篷睡覺。

items.audioEn: The craft fair starts at ten on Saturday in the school hall.
items.audioZh: 手工藝市集星期六十點在學校禮堂開始。
items.questionZh: 手工藝市集在哪裡舉行？
options: In the park near the station.
At the market next to the river.

items.sentenceEn: She has written three books of poetry.
The film is a comedy about two old friends on a road trip.
items.sentenceZh: 這部電影是一部關於兩位老朋友公路旅行的喜劇。

items.stemEn: The ____ of the film is easy to follow.
items.stemZh: 這部電影的敘事很容易看懂。

items.stemEn: Many people believe the ____ that the lake has no bottom.
items.stemZh: 很多人相信「那座湖沒有底」這個迷思。

items.passageEn: Every spring, our town holds a literary festival in a big white tent. This year, a young poet read poetry about the sea, and a writer talked about the narrative of his new book. In another room, an old man told old myths about the stars. There was also a comedy show that made everyone laugh. My favorite part was the craft market, where I bought a cup as a souvenir. The weather was perfect, which felt like a small miracle after a week of rain.
items.passageZh: 每年春天，我們鎮上都會在一個大白帳篷裡舉辦文學節。今年，一位年輕詩人朗讀關於大海的詩，一位作家談他新書的敘事。在另一個房間，一位老先生講述關於星星的古老神話。還有一場讓大家笑個不停的喜劇表演。我最喜歡的是手工藝市集，我在那裡買了一個杯子當紀念品。天氣好極了，在下了一星期雨之後，感覺像個小奇蹟。

questions.questionZh: 那位老先生講了什麼樣的故事？
作者在手工藝市集買了什麼？

rubricZh: comedy 表示「喜劇」，可數名詞，例如 a comedy 等說法
時態配合內容（多用現在簡單式）

items.instructionZh: 用 miracle 造一個句子，說說一件你覺得像奇蹟的事。
referenceEn: It was a miracle that I passed the test.
Finding my lost wallet felt like a miracle.
rubricZh: miracle 表示「奇蹟」，例如 It was a miracle that…、feel like a miracle 等說法
說的是自己的經驗（例如 I、my）
時態配合內容（例如說過去的事用過去式）
